speaker: VOICE
text: You're inside the Asterion now (or what your mind kept of it). The corridors are right. The things walking them are not.

speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: They don't look at me. They look for me.

speaker: VOICE
text: Corrupted memories. Stay out of their sight, crouch in the dark patches if one comes near.

speaker: VOICE
text: There's a research terminal to the east. Reach it, and hold E to investigate. It takes a moment, and it makes noise. They will hear it.
